description: Agent preflight round 2: check a handover package before a receiver takes over. Input text, fields (credentials, runbooks, billing, domains, data_export, obligations) or both. The signed report marks credentials and custody transfer, runbooks, billing ownership, domains and DNS, data export and open obligations covered, partial or not covered, with quotes; states what a receiver could and could not run on day one; and names each gap. POST /api/handover-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no registry or chain lookup, no counterparty contact, and no payment signed, submitted or moved. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-preflight-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/preflight/.

inputSchema.description: Send the text, the fields or both.

fields.description: The package by area. A field given here takes precedence over the text for that area.

billing.description: How billing ownership and payment methods change hands.

credentials.description: How credentials and key custody pass to the receiver.

data_export.description: How and where the data is exported for the receiver.

domains.description: How domains, DNS and certificates transfer.

obligations.description: The open obligations: contracts, SLAs, open orders, refunds or escrow, or a statement that there are none.

runbooks.description: The runbooks and where they are.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.

text.description: The handover package description as written, up to 64 KB.

name: wever_handover-check
title: Handover check
